slides.title: AI tutor jo *seedha answer* nahi deta
slides.subtitle: Khanmigo: Khan Academy ka AI tutor.

slides.title: *Khanmigo* kya hai?
slides.body: Khanmigo is Khan Academy's AI-powered teaching assistant and tutor.

slides.title: Answer nahi, *sochna* sikhata hai
slides.body: For learners, Khanmigo challenges you to think critically and solve problems without giving you direct answers.

slides.title: Writing *practice* ke liye
slides.body: Khanmigo also has an AI-enhanced writing practice and instruction tool. Its site says you can sign up for it for free.

slides.title: Kaise use karein?
bullets: Availability aur price *site pe* check karo

slides.title: Kaam ka laga?
slides.text: Har hafte naye AI tools, students ke liye.
